title: First Image of a Black Hole
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESO usage policy, https://www.eso.org/public/outreach/copyright/); credit must be shown unaltered
image_kind: image reconstructed from interferometric data with computational imaging; colour map applied (not visible light)
processing_notes: Note: M87* is a supermassive black hole, not a stellar-mass black hole like the one in STELLARIS; shown as the only directly imaged black-hole shadow.
derivative_operations: none: the file is used exactly as downloaded; at run time it is decoded and uploaded to the GPU as RGBA8 with mipmaps for display only
intended_use: Observation view reference panel; displayed unmodified with its credit line beside it, compared side by side with the STELLARIS procedural scene, which is labelled a conceptual visualization and not a reconstruction.
